# Omar Aboelella

> London-based AI product engineer, Computer Science and Mathematics student, and maths and science tutor.

## Work and study

- AI product engineering at Digis Squared, including technical strategy, MAPE-K reasoning, Bayesian inference and LangGraph workflows for KATANA.
- Previous experience includes predictive modelling at Bitget and competitor-research reporting automation at bp.
- Founder of NOOKBASE, an in-development multi-agent learning product with a public early-access list and interactive demos. The product is not yet generally available.
- Computer Science and Mathematics at Birkbeck, University of London, with expected graduation in 2028.
- Mathematics and Physics Teaching Assistant at Southfields Academy.
- Research interests include AI and learning, optimisation, quantitative finance and quantum computing. These are exploratory interests, not claims of published results or doctoral enrolment.

Lesson and project enquiries are conversations, not confirmed bookings. Availability and pricing are agreed directly with Omar.

## Website attribution

The homepage uses an edited 20-second live-action film of computing hardware,
mathematical study, programming and London. Footage is licensed from Mixkit;
it is not footage of Omar, his projects or his workplace.
Its Selected Work wheel adapts the user-supplied CrafterUI Works Wheel under
MIT, retaining its ring-to-drum geometry with accessible production controls.
Earlier workspace/template source remains recoverable but is not rendered.
